character_ability.name: STAR POWER
character_ability.description: Annie now builds up STAR POWER meter over time, and can activate STAR POWER when above 50% meter. During STAR POWER MODE, Annie's basic attacks produce STARS that deal full damage on BLOCKED HITS, and many of Annie's SPECIAL MOVES have additional properties.

marquee_options.name: REDSHIFT
marquee_options.description: Each SPECIAL MOVE or BLOCKBUSTER used grants 15/25% bonus damage to SPECIAL MOVES and BLOCKBUSTERS for the rest of the combo

marquee_options.name: BLUESHIFT
marquee_options.description: Opponents deal 20/40% less damage on each COMBO HIT under 5

prestige.name: STARBURST
prestige.description: Annie charges this ability when using STAR POWER METER. CHARGE RATE: 2% per 1% STAR POWER METER spent. ACTIVATION EFFECT: Annie's STAR POWER STARS deal 50/120% bonus damage.

character_ability.name: HYPE MODE
character_ability.description: Get 1 Hype Charge with every THROW and every 30 seconds. 3 Hype Charges lets you trigger HYPE MODE! During HYPE MODE, THROWS cannot be broken, and many attacks feature surprising upgrades.

marquee_options.name: CHALLENGER
marquee_options.description: Beowulf regains 1/2% HEALTH per second anytime his HEALTH% is LOWER than his opponent.

marquee_options.name: DEFENDING CHAMP
marquee_options.description: Beowulf deals 10/20% bonus damage anytime his HEALTH% is HIGHER than his opponent's

prestige.name: NOW OR NEVER
prestige.description: Beowulf charges this ability when entering HYPE MODE. CHARGE RATE: 50% per HYPE MODE ENTRY. ACTIVATION EFFECT: Beowulf deals 15/30% bonus damage in HYPE MODE for every 20 seconds elapsed during the match.

character_ability.name: CAN'T STOP THE BEAT
character_ability.description: While dashing, Big Band can absorb ONE hit without being interrupted (but will take damage normally).

marquee_options.name: SOLOIST
marquee_options.description: Gain HEAVY REGEN for 10 seconds and take 30/50% less damage when absorbing the first HIT while DASHING

marquee_options.name: FRONTMAN
marquee_options.description: Take 5/15% less damage and gain 30% RESISTANCE while Big Band has living teammates

prestige.name: BLAST BEAT
prestige.description: Big Band charges this ability on every 10th COMBO HIT landed on him or the opponent. CHARGE RATE: 15% per 10th COMBO HIT. ACTIVATION EFFECT: Big Band's DASH ATTACKS gain a 25%/60% chance to be UNBLOCKABLE and grant ENRAGE for 5 seconds.

character_ability.name: SHARPSHOOTER
character_ability.description: Tap the SHARPSHOOTER button to fire SHOTS! Tap the RELOAD button to load 6 new SHOTS. When reloading, the third shot type is determined by Black Dahlia's ELEMENT and the sixth is random.

marquee_options.name: METAL BREAKDOWN
marquee_options.description: SPECIAL SHOTS inflict 20/30% bonus damage and inflict ARMOR BREAK for 10 seconds (also applies on blocked hits).

marquee_options.name: NO TIME TO DIE
marquee_options.description: 30/50% chance when the opponent lands a CRITICAL HIT to gain REGEN and HASTE for 10 seconds each.

prestige.name: TRIGGER MORTIS
prestige.description: Black Dahlia charges this ability each time she FIRES a SHOT. CHARGE RATE: 17% per SHOT fired. ACTIVATION EFFECT: Once activated, Black Dahlia inflicts DEATH MARK and gains DEADEYE for 10/15 seconds each when RELOADING.

character_ability.name: BALANCING ACT
character_ability.description: THROW BREAKS cause enemies to be STAGGERED.

marquee_options.name: UPPER HAND
marquee_options.description: THROWS reduce BLOCKBUSTER METER by 20/30%

marquee_options.name: RINGLEADER
marquee_options.description: THROWS DISABLE the opponent's TAG INS and SPECIAL MOVES for 5/15 seconds

prestige.name: THE HARDER THEY FALL
prestige.description: Cerebella charges this ability each time she THROWS or is THROWN by her opponents. CHARGE RATE: 20% per THROW. ACTIVATION EFFECT: Cerebella's THROWS deal bonus damage equal to 50/100% of her opponent's remaining HEALTH percentage.

character_ability.name: TRANSMUTATION
character_ability.description: After BLOCKING without being hit for 1 second, Double will switch to a new random element (except Neutral).When at an ELEMENTAL ADVANTAGE, Double's damage increases by 10%.When at an ELEMENTAL DISADVANTAGE, opponent damage decreases by 10%.

marquee_options.name: CHAOS
marquee_options.description: When at an ELEMENTAL ADVANTAGE, inflict a random DEBUFF for 5/15 seconds when landing a CRITICAL HIT

marquee_options.name: VOLATILITY
marquee_options.description: Every 20/10 seconds gain a random BUFF for 10 seconds

prestige.name: DOUBLE JEOPARDY
prestige.description: Double charges this ability each time she TRANSMUTES. CHARGE RATE: 13% per TRANSMUTATION. ACTIVATION EFFECT: The effects of Double's ELEMENTAL ADVANTAGE are increased by 40/100%.

character_ability.name: WARRIOR GODDESS
character_ability.description: BLOCKBUSTERS involving Sekhmet now leave Eliza in Sekhmet Mode for a short duration. All damage taken while in Sekhmet Mode is recoverable.

marquee_options.name: BLOOD OATH
marquee_options.description: Whenever a teammate is defeated, Eliza regains 30/50% HEALTH

marquee_options.name: RITUAL SACRIFICE
marquee_options.description: Whenever a teammate is defeated, Eliza gains 50/100% BLOCKBUSTER METER

prestige.name: FEAST AND FAMINE
prestige.description: Eliza charges this ability each time she enters SEKHMET MODE. CHARGE RATE: 25% per ENTRY. ACTIVATION EFFECT: Eliza gains a 5/20% chance on each NON-BLOCKBUSTER HIT in SEKHMET MODE (including blocked hits) to REMOVE 1 opponent BUFF and gain 5% HEALTH.

character_ability.name: FLASH BACK
character_ability.description: Back-dashing just before being HIT will allow Filia to EVADE the opponent's attack, avoiding all damage.

marquee_options.name: LEECH
marquee_options.description: 15/35% of the damage Filia inflicts is regained as HEALTH

marquee_options.name: THE FIRST CUT
marquee_options.description: Every HIT has a 5/15% chance to convert all active BLEEDS to permanent BLEEDS

prestige.name: BOB AND WEAVE
prestige.description: Filia charges this ability each time she HITS an attacking opponent or is HIT while attacking. CHARGE RATE: 20% per HIT. ACTIVATION EFFECT: Filia EVADES all projectiles while DASHING and has a 50/100% chance to inflict DEATH MARK for 5 seconds when HITTING an attacking opponent.

character_ability.name: SANGUINE SHADOW
character_ability.description: All of the damage Fukua receives is inflicted as non-permanent SCRATCH DAMAGE.

marquee_options.name: SPECTRAL SPITE
marquee_options.description: Deal 1% bonus damage for every 15/5% HEALTH missing

marquee_options.name: WRAITH'S WRATH
marquee_options.description: Reduce damage taken by 1% for every 15/5% HEALTH missing

prestige.name: DREAM EATER
prestige.description: Fukua charges this ability each time she or the opponent uses a BLOCKBUSTER. CHARGE RATE: 25% per BLOCKBUSTER. ACTIVATION EFFECT: Fukua drains 5/10% of the opponent's BLOCKBUSTER METER and inflicts HEAL BLOCK for 5 seconds when using a BLOCKBUSTER.

character_ability.name: REST AND RESURRECTION
character_ability.description: Hold down the REST AND RESURRECTION button to build a MORTUARY CHARGE. When charged, tap the button to REVIVE nearby defeated allies and INCINERATE nearby opponent corpses!

marquee_options.name: IMPROVED INCINERATION
marquee_options.description: Gain 15/25% BLOCKBUSTER METER and ENRAGE when INCINERATING a dead body.

marquee_options.name: REINFORCED REVIVAL
marquee_options.description: While Marie is alive, teammates gain permanent ARMOR and an additional 15/25% HEALTH when REVIVED.

prestige.name: CALL OF THE GRAVE
prestige.description: Marie charges this ability each time a BUFF or DEBUFF expires on either Fighter while she is TAGGED IN. CHARGE RATE: 14% per BUFF or DEBUFF expiration. ACTIVATION EFFECT: Once activated, Marie inflicts QUIETUS for 10/15 seconds each time she uses a MORTUARY CHARGE.

character_ability.name: HEAD GAMES
character_ability.description: Tap the HEAD GAMES button to enter HEADLESS MODE. Ms. Fortune's head can attack independent of her body. But be careful: Ms. Fortune will also suffer any additional damage inflicted to her head!

marquee_options.name: MLEM
marquee_options.description: Gain REGEN for 10/20 seconds after every 10 seconds not suffering a HIT (includes blocked hits)

marquee_options.name: BOOP
marquee_options.description: Gain ENRAGE for 10/20 seconds after every 10 seconds not suffering a HIT (includes blocked hits)

prestige.name: FUR AND BLUR
prestige.description: Ms. Fortune charges this ability based on her MOVE SPEED. CHARGE RATE: 1.5% of her MOVE SPEED. ACTIVATION EFFECT: Ms. Fortune gains EVASION and inflicts GUARD BREAK for 5 seconds each every 10/5 seconds.

character_ability.name: FLIGHT RISK
character_ability.description: Tap the FLIGHT RISK button to hover in the air! Tap the button again to land. While flying, gain access to new actions by swiping and tapping.

marquee_options.name: TAINTED BLOOD
marquee_options.description: When an opponent lands a CRITICAL HIT, 50/100% of the damage will be reflected back

marquee_options.name: GRUDGE
marquee_options.description: When the opponent lands a CRITICAL HIT, gain ENRAGE for 10/20 seconds and ARMOR for 5 seconds

prestige.name: NOWHERE TO HIDE
prestige.description: Painwheel charges this ability each time she or her opponent lands a CRITICAL HIT. CHARGE RATE: 4% per CRITICAL HIT. ACTIVATION EFFECT: Painwheel inflicts GUARD BREAK for 5/10 seconds when using a BLOCKBUSTER.

character_ability.name: TEARFUL
character_ability.description: Certain attacks will now spawn a TEAR. Using a CHARGE ATTACK will detonate all active TEARS, damaging opponents caught in the blast.

marquee_options.name: CRITICAL THINKING
marquee_options.description: Parasoul gains a 15/25% bonus to CRIT RATE per ACTIVE TEAR

marquee_options.name: CRITICAL MASS
marquee_options.description: Parasoul gains a 10/20% bonus to CRIT DAMAGE per ACTIVE TEAR

prestige.name: DEADLY ACCURACY
prestige.description: Parasoul charges this ability each time she spawns a TEAR. CHARGE RATE: 12% per TEAR. ACTIVATION EFFECT: Parasoul gains PRECISION every 7/2 second(s) while near a TEAR.

character_ability.name: THE HOLE IDEA
character_ability.description: Tap THE HOLE IDEA button to vanish into a hole, avoiding some attacks. Tap elsewhere to emerge with a wallop! Otherwise, tap the button again or wait 2 seconds to exit without attacking.

marquee_options.name: SPECIAL FEATURE
marquee_options.description: When Peacock uses a SPECIAL MOVE, there is a 10/30% chance that the COOLDOWN will immediately reset

marquee_options.name: CAST PARTY
marquee_options.description: When Peacock or any teammate uses a TAG IN, there is a 30/50% chance that the attack will be UNBLOCKABLE

prestige.name: MANIC MUNITIONS
prestige.description: Peacock charges this ability each time she or the opponent is damaged by a PROJECTILE. CHARGE RATE: 3% per PROJECTILE. ACTIVATION EFFECT: Peacock has a 25/50% chance to gain 1 stack of ENRAGE for 5 seconds, HASTE for 5 seconds, or PRECISION when using a SPECIAL MOVE.

character_ability.name: HEADRONE HARDWARE
character_ability.description: Tap the LAUNCH button to launch HEADRONES. Use HEADRONES to ram enemies, set proximity mines, and fire a barrage of missiles!

marquee_options.name: DDOS
marquee_options.description: Inflicts POWER SURGE for 5/15 seconds after every 3 seconds while near the opponent

marquee_options.name: PING CHECK
marquee_options.description: Gain ENRAGE for 5/15 seconds after every 2 seconds while far away from the opponent

prestige.name: GEIGER COUNTER
prestige.description: Robo-Fortune charges this ability each time she gains a BUFF or inflicts a DEBUFF. CHARGE RATE: 7% per BUFF or DEBUFF. ACTIVATION EFFECT: Robo-Fortune gains 5 stacks of PRECISION and reflects 5/20% of the damage she takes for every BUFF on her or the opponent (max 100%).

character_ability.name: WYRM'S TAIL
character_ability.description: Holding down the WYRM'S TAIL button will store up to 2 DRAGON CHARGES. DRAGON CHARGES are consumed to make certain attacks more powerful!

marquee_options.name: EVIL DEAD
marquee_options.description: While enemies are nearby Squigly's dead body, teammates' HITS inflict CURSE and WITHER for 5/15 seconds

marquee_options.name: DEAD ALIVE
marquee_options.description: While teammates are nearby Squigly's dead body, suffering a HIT will grant them FINAL STAND for 5/15 seconds

prestige.name: STAY TOMBED
prestige.description: Squigly charges this ability each time she gains or uses a DRAGON CHARGE. CHARGE RATE: 12% per DRAGON CHARGE gained or used. ACTIVATION EFFECT: Any currently defeated opponents can no longer be revived and Squigly gains DRAGON CHARGE every 7/2 seconds while near a dead body.

character_ability.name: HUNGERN'S HUNGER
character_ability.description: THROWS fill the meter and BUBBLE-based moves (including tapping the meter button) empty it. Basic attacks deal more damage while OVERSTUFFED and are faster while RAVENOUS. Certain moves are empowered by Hungern's state!

marquee_options.name: SWEET VICTORY
marquee_options.description: Gain 2 stacks of ENRAGE for 5/15 seconds when defeating an opponent

marquee_options.name: BITTER END
marquee_options.description: Once per match, gain FINAL STAND and HEAVY REGEN for 5/15 seconds each when falling below 25% HEALTH

prestige.name: GUT REACTION
prestige.description: Umbrella charges this ability each time she gains or loses HUNGER. CHARGE RATE: 1% per 1% HUNGER gained or lost. ACTIVATION EFFECT (Hunger gauge will lower by one bar): Umbrella gains 5% HEALTH and inflicts SLIME for 10/15 seconds when HITTING an attacking opponent.

character_ability.name: SIPHON
character_ability.description: More of the damage Valentine receives is inflicted as non-permanent SCRATCH DAMAGE. 75% of the damage Valentine deals is regained as HEALTH, but only up to her current SCRATCH DAMAGE threshold.

marquee_options.name: TRAUMA CENTER
marquee_options.description: While Valentine is alive, teammates gain FINAL STAND for 5/15 seconds when suffering a HIT that deals more than 10% HEALTH

marquee_options.name: ICU
marquee_options.description: Valentine gains HEAVY REGEN for 10/20 seconds when suffering a DEBUFF

prestige.name: REANIMATOR
prestige.description: Valentine charges this ability each time she recovers HEALTH while TAGGED IN. CHARGE RATE: 4% for each 1% HEALTH recovered. ACTIVATION EFFECT: All defeated teammates are REVIVED with 10% HEALTH and Valentine continuously gains 0.75/2% HEALTH per second.
